# Filter rows where the 2018 intent is "Running" or "Retiring" (since those are the only non-missing intents in the table)
intent_series = df["2018 intent"]
running_or_retiring = intent_series.isin(["Running", "Retiring"])

# Get the party of those incumbents
parties = df.loc[running_or_retiring, "Incumbent\nParty"]

# Count Republicans and Democrats
republican_count = (parties == "Republican").sum()
democrat_count = (parties == "Democratic").sum()

# Create answer as a string describing the counts
answer = f"Republicans: {republican_count}, Democrats: {democrat_count}"
